info.title: Govener Administration API
info.description: Separate administrative authority. ROOT accesses every community; ADMIN only assigned communities. Manager/resident memberships grant no administrative access. Root is bootstrapped through deployment configuration, never HTTP.

get.description: Community membership and operation permissions are enforced server-side. All object references must belong to the path community.

post.description: Creates an HttpOnly Secure SameSite session cookie. Rate limited; invalid credentials use a generic response. Obtain CSRF material before cookie-authenticated writes.

AdminUserCreate.description: RESIDENT requires unitId, relationshipType and startsOn, with exactly the four read permissions. MANAGER requires COMMUNITY_READ and rejects relationship fields. Email must identify a new account; no existing-account linking.

SessionCookie.name: govener_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie; never persist session secrets in web storage.
